name: 2nd AE2 Conference of the Australian and New Zealand Association of Econometricians (ANZAE)
organizer: Australian and New Zealand Association of Econometricians (ANZAE / AE2); hosted by the University of Sydney
venue: The Sutherland Room, Holme Building, Camperdown/Darlington Campus, The University of Sydney
submission_requirements: Full papers in PDF to AE2.conference@sydney.edu.au; indicate eligibility for the early-career awards (PhD candidates or doctorate within the past two years).
registration_fee: AUD 240 ANZAE member academic / AUD 300 non-member academic / AUD 130 member student / AUD 160 non-member student (includes sessions, lunches and dinner)
